text:
sam: Quick sync — we need to lock the tenant rate-limit matrix (RPM/TPM + concurrency) and fallback behavior for next week's rollout. My proposal below.

maya: 👍 share the matrix

sam: Proposed rules:
- RPM/TPM are primary soft limits (token-bucket) with a burst budget of 3x sustained for 5 minutes.
- Concurrency is a hard cap (per-org) enforced at the router; if concurrency reached, reject 429 immediately.
- If RPM exceeded but concurrency under cap, allow short-lived requests up to burst budget; beyond that return 429 and log as `quota.exceeded`.
- Fallback: when both RPM/TPM and concurrency are over threshold, route to cheaper /fallback model variant with reduced max_tokens.

liam: Couple notes: leaky bucket vs token bucket semantics matter for burst budget. Token-bucket is easier to reason with burst credits. Also need to track per-org `inflight_streams` for streamed responses.

ana: Router can enforce concurrency. For the fallback routing, we need deterministic policy: prefer model variant in same region, then allow cross-region if tenant allows it. Also: audit logs must include which rule triggered fallback.

devex: Console asks: can we surface 'effective limit' after routing? i.e., show user CPU/cost-adjusted rate and current burst balance. Would help support/SEs.

sam: Yes — telemetry plan: emit metrics `tenant.rate_limit.{allowed,denied,fallback}` with labels {org_id, route, region, reason}, and a gauge `tenant.burst_credits`.

ops-bot: Incident note from 2169900000 — tenant abc123 hit concurrency cap and got 429s; customer escalated. Tagging @sam @maya for follow-up.

maya: For UX: add a per-org "grace window" readout (seconds remaining on burst) and a "predictive headroom" graph (1h lookahead) on console.

liam: Implementation plan: router will check concurrency first -> if full return 429; else check tokens -> if tokens available serve; else if burst credits available decrement and tag request; else route to fallback if tenant has fallback flag otherwise 429.

ana: Edge-case: long-poll streams that start under tokens but run long — we should charge TPM continuously and pre-reserve concurrency slot while stream open.

sam: Agreed. I'll update the PR with the matrix and sample numbers:
```
RPM=1200
TPM=300000
concurrency=50
burst_window=300s
burst_multiplier=3
```

maya: Add unit tests for refunding burst credits on aborted requests.

liam: I'll pick up the router changes. ETA end of week.

sam: Cool. If no objections by EOD I'll merge and create rollout plan with canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

maya: No objections. :thumbsup:

ana: +1 from security side for audit logging.

devex: I'll prototype the console widgets next sprint.

sam: Thanks everyone.
